humanize_prompt_template.description: Prompt used to rewrite an agent's raw answer into a natural WhatsApp-toned reply before sending.

business_persona_context.description: Free-text instructions for how Adiyan should sound to this business's customers - tone, brand voice, fallback phrasing. Empty on the platform layer (no persona) by default; a real value only ever comes from a vertical override, written by mesh/config_agent/skills/apply_vertical_spec.py from an uploaded vertical-spec YAML. Applied only when the sender is not the owner - see humanize()'s own docstring.

open_enrollment.description: False (the platform default) on every vertical unless its own spec explicitly sets it true - a real vertical then auto-registers a first-time stranger's very first summoned message with zero signup step, the same zero-friction grant demo verticals already get unconditionally (see rules_engine.py's _is_open_enrollment()). Seeded here as a real boolean, not left unset, so a vertical spec's own true/false value coerces correctly instead of landing as an always-truthy string - see mesh/config_agent/skills/update_config.py's _coerce() for why matching an existing typed default matters.

session_carry_over.description: False (the platform default) on every vertical unless its own spec explicitly sets it true - a real vertical then extends demo verticals' own 30-minute phrase-less follow-up window (db.SESSION_WINDOW_SECONDS) to its own real customers, via rules_engine.py's _has_session_carry_over(). Seeded here as a real boolean for the exact same reason open_enrollment above is - confirmed live: applying a spec with this key before it had any seeded default coerced the new value into the literal string 'True' instead of a real bool, since _coerce() matches types against whatever's currently stored and an unseeded key's current value is a bare empty string.
